In parallelogram $ABCD$ shown above, which of the following equalities are true?

- $\overset{\to }{AD}=\overset{\to }{CB}$
- $\overset{\to }{DC}+\overset{\to }{CB}=\overset{\to }{DB}$
- $\overset{\to }{AD}+\overset{\to }{DF}=\overset{\to }{FA}$

feedback.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14073669/assets/e17584d96cb8d83ccb1abfbd16c4117f58639b7cd3462ee50ad3f31e4eabe279.png)

In figure $ABCDEF$ shown above, which of the following equalities are true?

- $\overset{\to }{BC}-\overset{\to }{DC}=\overset{\to }{BD}$
- $\overset{\to }{BA}+\overset{\to }{AE}-\overset{\to }{FE}=\overset{\to }{BF}$
- $\overset{\to }{CD}-\overset{\to }{ED}-\overset{\to }{FE}=\overset{\to }{FC}$
feedback.worked_solution:
- Equality I is true. Indeed, 

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{BC}-\overset{\to }{DC} & =\overset{\to }{BC}+\overset{\to }{CD} \\  & =\overset{\to }{BD}.\end{aligned}
$$

- Equality II is true. Indeed, 

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{BA}+\overset{\to }{AE}-\overset{\to }{FE} & =\overset{\to }{BA}+(\overset{\to }{AE}+\overset{\to }{EF}) \\  & =\overset{\to }{BA}+\overset{\to }{AF} \\  & =\overset{\to }{BF}.\end{aligned}
$$

- Equality III is false. Indeed,

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{CD}-\overset{\to }{ED}-\overset{\to }{FE} & =(\overset{\to }{CD}+\overset{\to }{DE})+\overset{\to }{EF} \\  & =\overset{\to }{CE}+\overset{\to }{EF} \\  & =\overset{\to }{CF} \\  & \ne \overset{\to }{FC}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the correct answer is "I and II only".
